title: When the Veil Burns
author: Rafael Hartwell
blurb: Elodie Oyelaran, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
